about.headlinePart1: Before you find your house, we want you to feel
about.body: Casa Madre begins with origin and intention — with the place where everything starts. And with a feeling we want to stay with you from the very first moment: that you are in good hands.

body: We don't sell houses. We accompany the moment someone decides where to truly begin living. That's why we work with few properties and a great deal of attention — with judgement and with calm, understanding first who you are and how you want to live.
We believe a home is far more than square metres. It's where the stories happen. And our work is to help you find the place where yours begin.

method.title: A way of working that repeats, until it becomes a method.
method.intro: We don't improvise. Every journey follows a way of working designed to understand you and care for every detail.

steps.title: Understand who you are
steps.body: Before showing you anything, we listen. We understand your moment, your way of living, and what you're truly looking for.

steps.title: Define the path
steps.body: We map a clear, personalised strategy — with judgement and without haste, shaped around your goal.

steps.title: Select with judgement
steps.body: We filter for you. We propose only what genuinely fits, so every visit has meaning.

steps.title: Tend to every detail
steps.body: We care for the entire process — the paperwork, the negotiation, the timing — through to closing, without friction.

steps.title: When it repeats, it becomes a method
steps.body: What works, we repeat. That consistency is what turns our way of working into something you can trust.

network.title: We work as one house.
body: Behind Casa Madre is a network of trusted professionals — lawyers, financial advisors, architects, interior designers and specialists — who work alongside us whenever a process calls for it.

We don't hand you off; we accompany you. We coordinate each specialist so you have a single point of contact, and everything unfolds with the same closeness and the same judgement from beginning to end.

ctaSection.title: Shall we begin imagining your home?
ctaSection.text: Tell us who you are and how you want to live. The rest, we build with you.

aviso.liabilityBody: Casa Madre is not liable for damages arising from improper use of the site or from information published by third parties. Property information is indicative and does not constitute a binding offer.
aviso.lawBody: These terms are governed by Spanish law. Any dispute shall be submitted to the courts and tribunals determined in accordance with the law.

privacidad.title: Privacy Policy
privacidad.intro: Casa Madre respects your privacy and processes your personal data in accordance with Regulation (EU) 2016/679 (GDPR) and Spanish Organic Law 3/2018 (LOPDGDD).
privacidad.dataBody: We collect the data you provide through the contact form: name, email, phone, area of interest, budget and the message you send us.
privacidad.purposeBody: We use your data solely to respond to your request, manage our relationship and provide information about our services. It is not used for automated decisions or profiling.
privacidad.legalBasisBody: The legal basis is your consent, given when you submit the form, and Casa Madre's legitimate interest in responding to your enquiry.
privacidad.retentionBody: We keep your data for as long as necessary to handle your request and, thereafter, for any legally required periods. It is then securely deleted.
privacidad.sharingBody: We do not share your data with third parties, except where legally required or with providers delivering necessary services (e.g. email delivery) under the corresponding data processing agreement.
privacidad.rightsBody: You may exercise your rights of access, rectification, erasure, objection, restriction and portability by writing to our contact email. You may also lodge a complaint with the Spanish Data Protection Agency (www.aepd.es).
privacidad.contactBody: For any question about your data, contact us using the details provided.

cookies.title: Cookie Policy
cookies.intro: This website uses only technical and necessary cookies required for it to function correctly.
cookies.whatBody: Cookies are small files stored on your device as you browse. They allow the site to work correctly and to remember certain preferences, such as language.
cookies.typesBody: We currently use only technical and preference cookies necessary for the site to function (for example, remembering your language). We do not use analytics, advertising or third-party tracking cookies.
cookies.consentBody: As only necessary technical cookies are used, no prior consent is required under current regulations. Should analytics or third-party cookies be added in future, your consent will be requested.
cookies.manageBody: You can configure or delete cookies through your browser settings at any time.
